 CORAM : S. G. MEHARE, J.
 DATE : 27.04.2023  PER COURT :-
 1.
Heard the learned counsel for the applicant and the  learned APP for the respondent-State.

2. The applicant is seeking bail in Crime No.133 of 2023,
 registered at Naldurg Police Station, District Osmanabad, for  the offences punishable under Sections 188, 328, 272, 273 of  the IPC and Sections 26(2)(i), 27(2)(e), 30(2)(a) and 59 of  Food Safety and Standards Act etc.
 3.
The applicant is a car owner in which the Gutkha was  seized.
Only Section 328 of the IPC is non bailable.

There is a material progress in the investigation.
In view of that matter, the applicant deserves bail.

Hence, the  following order :
 ORDER (i) Bail Application is allowed.
(ii) Applicant ROHIT SANJAY RATHOD be released on bail on furnishing P.B. and S.B. of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount, in Crime No.133 of 2023, registered at Naldurg Police Station, District Osmanabad, for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 328, 272, 273 of the IPC and Sections 26(2)(i), 27(2)(e), 30(2)(a)
and 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act etc., on the condition that he shall attend the Police Station as and when called by the Investigating Officer on written notice till filing charge sheet.
